description: What a person said, objected to or agreed with: stance sentences of their own words, labelled by rule. "What did Tom Lane object to in SIGFPE handling": author + topic. "Who objected to what in this thread", "why did this patch stall": message_id (every participant; add author for one). Each sentence is verbatim own text (whitespace collapsed) with message_id, url, date, from; stance opposes, concerned, supports or commits, with the cue and source: rule ("I'm not convinced", "-1", "makes sense") or commitfest (a review status: Waiting on Author = concerned, Ready for Committer = supports). A label is a rule's classification, not the person's view: read the sentence. Threads in search order with a topic, else newest first; objections first in a thread. counts by stance; messages_read (max 400) and complete=false when a cap or budget_ms cut the read, or the author search found nothing in time and the topic alone chose threads (note says). Sentences without a cue word are not returned (read the message).

author.description: One person: name, address or hash:<8 hex>

message_id.description: Message-ID or archive URL of any message in the thread

since.description: From (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago)

topic.description: Words or a question; with author, their messages on it (every message, not one per thread)

name: said
